_about: Checks excluded from the nightly vendored-spec run. No-silent-caps: every entry carries a reason, and this file is SHARED WITH THE VERIFICATION TEAM for agreement (their review condition 2-2) — an exclusion is a spec/seed gap to resolve, not a way to make the gate green. Keys: modules.<name> excludes a whole module; checks."<module>:<tc>" excludes one check. EMPTY SINCE 2026-08-13: the twenty-one entries this file used to carry were resolved at the source rather than carved out. Eleven expected 403 where existence-hiding returns 404, and five more encoded behaviour (case-sensitive action filter, page_size 1000, API-key scope, name uniqueness) that the guides settled the other way — all re-stated in the specs. Three were bound to the original campaign's environment (pinned UUIDs, a team topology) and now resolve their targets by name. One was a spec defect: TC-HEALTH-01-005's regex spanned two keys with [^}]* and broke on a field added to the response since. The last, TC-BACKUP-06-005, needed an auto backup that only the midnight Beat job makes, so the nightly workflow now calls that same task instead of excluding the check. Add entries back only with a reason that says which of those categories applies.
